events.title: PostReady: PR #612 — Cap video batches at 3 per run
events.description: Fixed video batch limits — video runs are now capped at 3 (vs 15 for images) to prevent burning expensive credits on unreviewed runs. Image batch limits unchanged.

events.title: PostReady: PR #611 — Schedule 'Where to post' defaults to all connected accounts (opt-out chips)
events.description: Schedule form now defaults to all connected accounts pre-selected, with opt-out chips so users can deselect specific platforms instead of opting in each time.

events.title: PostReady: PR #610 — Batch quantity chips + collapsed prompt cards
events.description: Added quantity chips to the batch creation flow and collapsed prompt cards for a cleaner, more scannable batch workspace UX.

events.title: PostReady: PR #609 — Fix second reference photo ignored when adding multiple files
events.description: Fixed a bug where adding a second reference photo (or dropping multiple files) caused the first upload to be silently dropped due to HEIC-conversion pipeline ordering.

events.title: PostReady: PR #608 — Fix HEIC conversion in all image inputs (reference photos, character photo, prompt studio)
events.description: Extended HEIC→JPEG conversion to cover all image input paths — reference photos, character photo, and Prompt Studio — fixing iPhone photo upload failures across the app.

events.title: PostReady: PR #607 — Fix caption y_offset floor (captions never burned)
events.description: Fixed a bug where caption y_offset of -220 exceeded fal's -200 floor, causing captions to silently never burn onto the video.

events.title: PostReady: PR #605 — Animate homepage How-it-works demo (self-playing Pro Prompt loop)
events.description: Added a self-playing animated demo loop on the homepage How-it-works section, showcasing Pro Prompt in action without user interaction.

events.title: PostReady: PR #606 — Surface fal auto-subtitle error bodies in caption failures
events.description: Fixed caption failure handling — fal auto-subtitle errors are now surfaced with full error body visibility, improving debuggability of subtitle generation failures.

events.title: PostReady: PR #604 — Fix multi-scene video captions cover the whole video
events.description: Fixed multi-scene video captions which were not covering the full video duration. Captions now span the entire video correctly.

events.title: PostReady: PR #603 — Review-to-post quote-card builder
events.description: Added a review-to-post quote-card builder that turns client reviews into branded, social-ready quote cards, making it easy to convert testimonials into polished posts.
